tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: a faintly sage-tinted off-white. Not cream, not pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, form fields, the itinerary panel: anything set on `surface`.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: The colour of the dry grass and the murram track in Mazingira's own photos, and of the guides' khaki uniforms. One band per page, for the invitation (the enquiry block). `ink`, `ink-muted` and `forest` read on it.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: The logo's sage. Logo, route-map landmarks, rules and decorative blocks. Never text in the light theme (2.5:1 on `surface`); put `on-sage` text on a sage fill.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet band and selected/hover fill. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `forest` all read on it.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on a `sage` fill (cover blocks, month-strip cells).

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The action colour, darkened from the olive of Mazingira's spare-wheel covers. Primary buttons, links, prices, the route line. Text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `dust` and `sage-soft` at 5.9:1 or more in both themes.

tokens.name: on-forest
tokens.usage: Text on a `forest` fill (primary button).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, meal plans, captions, "per person". 4.85:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: borders, table rules, the route map's unvisited landmarks.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp button fill only. Always with `on-whatsapp` text and the word "WhatsApp".

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Text on `whatsapp` (7.9:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. One per page. The sample is a draft to agree with Jacob.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles: trip, park and guide pages.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, itinerary day numbers and titles, guide names.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Tailor-made safaris led by Tanzanian guides since 2007.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rise early for breakfast before departing with a packed lunch for the Serengeti.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Lake Duluti Lodge, bed and breakfast
styles.usage: Meta lines, captions, form hints, footer.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels above values (fact strip, form fields, price table). Sentence case, no tracking, `ink-muted`. There is no all-caps text style.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, with tabular numerals. Always followed by a `small` "per person" label.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), page gutter minimum.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero and major band padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Form fields, table cells, month-strip cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels. The largest corner in the system: photos are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The WhatsApp button only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating WhatsApp button on mobile. Nothing else has a shadow.
